THE 1943 PIVOT: THE LIMITS
OF BORROWED DOGMA
By 1943, the global landscape is shifting. The leadership realizes
that importing foreign revolutionary models-whether Soviet or
Chinese-will inevitably fail if not adapted to local material
realities. This initiates a fierce critique of 'flunkeyism' (the dogmatic
worship of foreign powers) and demands a radical localized turn.
We are not starting from scratch... If we lack that intense patriotism which
defends the dignity of our country, we would not have become true patriots.

SYNTHESIS: THE GENESIS OF THE JUCHE FRAMEWORK
MILITARY (1930S)
The doctrine of surviving
without state backing through
self-armed guerrilla bases.
POLITICAL (1930S)
The fierce reiection of
factionalism, "Leftist" dogmatism,
and reliance on the Comintern.
JUCHE (SELF-RELIANCE)
The unified theory that the masters of
the Korean revolution are the Korean
people themselves. The revolution
must be executed in total
independence, tailored precisely to the
material realities of the homeland.
CULTURAL (1943)
The mandate to root Marxist-
Leninist principles explicitly in
Korean history and geography.
